_notes.about: The old to new map of the pre-1.0 rename. tools/migrate.py reads it; CHANGELOG.md prints the same table. Add entries as a stage lands, never remove one (an install that skipped a release still needs it).
_notes.repos: GitHub repository names, owner-less: the owner of each manifest URL stays as it is. Applied to manifest `repo` URLs and printed; the repository itself is renamed or recreated by the maintainer, so `migrate.py --apply` rewrites URLs only with --repos.
_notes.files: Paths relative to the claude home (and to a layer repo): globals, rules and dirs named in layer.json, and @imports in generated files. Every global file name is unique across layers (compose refuses two layers that ship the same name), so each layer prefixes its own.
_notes.skills: Skill folder names. Alias folders keep the old name working for one minor release.
_notes.removed_after: The release that drops the old names (deprecation window, GOVERNANCE.md).
_notes.retired: Files and folders that left superego. Their content now lives in the layer named on the right; migrate.py removes the old file once that layer is active.
